homepage.subtitle: Here's what's happening with your practice today

landing.hero-title: The Future of Dental Practice Management
landing.hero-subtitle: Automate repetitive tasks. Protect patient data. Empower your team with AI. A next-generation CRM system designed specifically for modern dental clinics.
landing.features-title: Everything You Need for Your Dental Practice
landing.features-subtitle: Our comprehensive suite of tools streamlines your workflow, enhances patient care, and boosts your practice efficiency.
landing.feature1-desc: Easily manage patient records, history, and appointments in one place.
landing.feature2-desc: Intuitive calendar interface for scheduling and managing appointments.
landing.feature3-desc: Create and track detailed treatment plans for each patient.
landing.feature4-desc: Generate invoices and manage payments with ease.
landing.feature5-desc: Gain insights into your practice with detailed analytics and reports.
landing.feature6-desc: Automated reminders and communications to reduce no-shows.
landing.feature-calendar-desc: Intelligent scheduling system with real-time availability, automated reminders, and seamless patient booking experience.
landing.feature-ai-notes-desc: Generate comprehensive patient summaries, treatment recommendations, and clinical notes instantly with our advanced AI technology.
landing.feature-patient-mgmt-desc: Organize patient records with powerful search, custom tagging, and complete medical history tracking in one intuitive interface.
landing.feature-analytics-desc: Gain valuable insights into your clinic's performance with customizable dashboards, financial reports, and patient satisfaction metrics.
landing.feature-suggestions-desc: Receive AI-driven recommendations for treatments, follow-ups, and patient communications based on clinical data and best practices.
landing.cta-title: Ready to Transform Your Dental Practice?
landing.cta-subtitle: Join thousands of dental professionals who have streamlined their practice management with DentalCRM.
landing.key-value-subtitle: Our platform combines powerful features with ease of use to transform your dental practice
landing.ai-powered-desc: Let AI handle the paperwork. Our system helps you generate patient summaries, recommendations, and clinical notes — instantly.
landing.gdpr-compliant-desc: We never share patient data with third parties. All AI features operate on anonymized inputs, fully compliant with European data protection laws.
landing.save-time-desc: No more redundant documentation. Automate follow-ups, create visit templates, and streamline appointment scheduling.
landing.security-desc: Data is encrypted, backed up, and hosted on secure European servers. Your clinic's privacy is always protected.
landing.data-protection-title: Your Patients' Data is Our Top Priority
landing.data-protection-subtitle: We treat your patients' data with the utmost care, implementing industry-leading security measures and maintaining complete transparency in our data handling practices.
landing.data-anonymization-title: Data anonymization before any AI processing
landing.data-anonymization-desc: All patient data is automatically anonymized before any AI analysis, ensuring complete privacy protection while maintaining clinical accuracy.
landing.no-storage-title: No storage of sensitive data without consent
landing.no-storage-desc: We never store sensitive patient information without explicit consent. Your patients maintain full control over their data at all times.
landing.gdpr-hosting-desc: Our infrastructure is hosted exclusively in European data centers with full GDPR compliance and regular third-party security audits.
landing.access-controls-title: Strict access controls and audit logging
landing.access-controls-desc: Multi-factor authentication, role-based permissions, and comprehensive audit trails ensure only authorized access to your clinic's data.
landing.security-footer: Trusted by 500+ dental practices across Europe
landing.security-disclaimer: Our security practices are regularly audited by independent third parties. We maintain SOC 2 Type II compliance and undergo annual penetration testing to ensure the highest level of data protection.
